## What it does

<!-- BEGIN AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->
Design Thinking learning curriculum covering nine progressive modules across the full Problem, Solution, and Implementation Space methods plus a shared manufacturing reference scenario for teaching and practice
<!-- END AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->

## When to use it

The DT Learning Tutor loads this curriculum to teach a method, check comprehension,
and assign practice. Nine modules span Problem, Solution, and Implementation
Spaces, with one shared fictional manufacturing scenario. Choose this route to
learn a technique; use DT Coach with `dt-methods` to work through a live project.

## Example usage

Ask DT Learning Tutor to teach Method 2, Design Research, at beginner level using
`dt-curriculum` and its manufacturing learning scenario. Request practice turning
"Would a dashboard help?" into an open discovery question, then designing an
observation plan for a night shift.

Expect the tutor to explain why environmental observation precedes interviews,
check your understanding, and review the exercise for leading questions and
missing constraints. Success is a learner-authored research plan that can reveal
surprises rather than confirm a preferred solution. Scenario observations and
test results are fictional teaching inputs, not findings from your workplace;
real observation requires appropriate participant consent and data handling.
